content.comment_body: Hello, I have just started programming in [product_name]. I am working on a program to control lighting that should operate during weekdays from 06:00 to 16:00. However, I need the lighting to stay off during weeks 28-31 and 51-52 due to holidays. I can't find any function to accomplish this directly. Any suggestions? Thanks!
For these weeks, you should block the output from the weekly timer using the output from a yearly timer. Unfortunately, you cannot specify calendar weeks directly, only date and month.
I have attached a simple example demonstrating this approach.
Thank you for your assistance. I will give this a try.

analysis.insight_summary: Users found that they cannot directly exclude specific calendar weeks from lighting schedules using the timer functions in [product_name]. The lack of a built-in feature for week-based exclusions means users have to implement workarounds using date and month selections, limiting flexibility for automation tasks tailored to holiday periods.
analysis.user_expectations: Users would like to see a simple way to exclude specific calendar weeks from timer-based automation schedules natively within the programming platform.
